about: Stability cases compared with ANDES (GPL-3.0; its published cases at a pinned commit, downloaded by scripts/fetch-reference.mjs into .cache/reference and never copied into the repository). scripts/oracle/andes_dyn.py runs each case in ANDES and writes tests/oracle/golden/dyn-<name>.json. 'overrides' change a parameter in both programs (scripts/oracle/andes_dyn.py says why); 'replace' gives a machine another control, written as a DYR record for ANDES and set on the engine's model, for models no published DYR case uses. 'loads' gives the loads' shares of constant power, current and impedance in %, for active and reactive power (ANDES's PQ.config p2p, p2i, p2z and q2q, q2i, q2z); without it loads are constant impedances. Events: 'fault' with its resistance rf and reactance xf in p.u. on the system base, 'clear', 'trip' and 'close' of a line. tstep is ANDES's fixed integration step, step the engine's, and sample the spacing of the recorded values, all in seconds. ANDES runs at a quarter of the engine's step because its anti-windup limits carry an error that shrinks with the step (docs/TESTING.md); ANDES adds a 0.1 ms step after each event, so the recorded times are its own, and the engine test interpolates its trajectory at them.

cases.name: kundur-gencls
cases.about: Kundur's two-area system with classical machines; the published event, one of the two tie lines between buses 8 and 9 switched out at 2 s.

cases.name: kundur-gencls-fault
cases.about: Kundur's two-area system with classical machines; a fault at bus 8, cleared after 100 ms.

cases.name: kundur-full
cases.about: Kundur's two-area system with GENROU machines, EXDC2 exciters and TGOV1 governors; the published event.

cases.name: kundur-full-fault
cases.about: As kundur-full, with a fault at bus 8 cleared after 100 ms.

cases.name: ieee14
cases.about: IEEE 14-bus system with GENROU machines, ESST3A, EXST1 exciters, TGOV1, IEEEG1 governors, IEEEST and ST2CUT stabilisers; the published event, line 1-2 switched out at 1 s and back in at 1.1 s.

cases.name: ieee14-fault
cases.about: As ieee14, with a fault at bus 9 cleared after 100 ms.

cases.name: wecc
cases.about: WECC 179-bus system with GENROU machines, IEEEG1 governors, EXST1, ESST3A, ESDC2A exciters and IEEEST, ST2CUT stabilisers; a fault at bus 3 cleared after 100 ms.

cases.name: kundur-sexs
cases.about: Kundur's two-area system with SEXS exciters in place of EXDC2, with the parameters of ANDES's kundur_sexs case; a fault at bus 8 cleared after 100 ms.

cases.name: ieee14-ieeet1
cases.about: The IEEE 14-bus system with an IEEET1 exciter at bus 8, as ANDES's ieee14_ieeet1 case places it, with ANDES's typical parameters; a fault at bus 9 cleared after 100 ms.

cases.name: ieee14-hygov
cases.about: The IEEE 14-bus system with a HYGOV governor at bus 8, as ANDES's ieee14_hygov case places it, with its parameters; line 2-5 switched out at 1 s.

cases.name: ieee14-zip
cases.about: The IEEE 14-bus system with voltage-dependent loads: 30 % constant power, 30 % constant current and 40 % constant impedance in active power, 20, 30 and 50 % in reactive power; line 2-5 switched out at 1 s.

cases.name: ieee14-esst1a
cases.about: The IEEE 14-bus system with an ESST1A exciter at bus 8, as ANDES's ieee14_esst1a case places it, with ANDES's typical parameters; a fault at bus 9 cleared after 100 ms. The values are listed in PowerStudio's DYR order (OpenIPSL's) under their names, and written for ANDES in its own order.
